# Broadcom VC4 DRM Driver Core (Upstream Import)

The source files in this directory (`vc4_drv.c`, `vc4_kms.c`, `vc4_crtc.c`, etc.)
were imported from the Linux kernel tree for NetBSD's `drm2` (Linux-KPI) subsystem.

- **Upstream Source**: Linux Kernel (`drivers/gpu/drm/vc4/`)
- **Upstream Tag/Commit**: `v5.6`
- **Import Date**: October 2026
- **License**: GPL-2.0 / Dual License (preserved as-is from Linux upstream)

## Imported Files
- `vc4_crtc.c`
- `vc4_drv.c`
- `vc4_drv.h`
- `vc4_hdmi.c`
- `vc4_hvs.c`
- `vc4_kms.c`
- `vc4_plane.c`
- `vc4_regs.h`
- `vc4_v3d.c`
